# See Something, Say Something: A Meta-Analytic Review of Safety Voice

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Catherine Curry, Sharon Clarke, V. McCarthy, S. Taylor  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** International Journal of Human Resource Management  
**DOI:** [10.1111/ijmr.12401](https://doi.org/10.1111/ijmr.12401)

**Keywords:** safety voice, employee voice, safety compliance, meta-analysis, safety management, organizational safety

## Abstract

A meta-analytic review of safety voice — employee speaking up about workplace safety issues — finding that safety voice is more prevalent in safety-supportive environments, positively associated with safety compliance, and helps explain employees' safety behavior.
